svg.title: AgilePlanner — Jira agent LLMOps lifecycle
svg.desc: Six connected stages: prepare Jira data, version prompts and golden data, evaluate candidates, review and activate, serve the Sprint Agent, observe and improve. Human feedback returns to versioning. An expanded runtime shows input screening, model-led read-only tools, MongoDB structured queries, SQLite hybrid retrieval, cited answers and traces.

g.text: PROJECT ARCHITECTURE / JIRA ANALYTICS + AI AGENT
One model or two; fresh memory
TURN REAL USAGE INTO NEW TESTS
HUMAN FEEDBACK → REVISE PROMPTS / TESTS → RE-EVALUATE
* Ragas uses a configured judge; scores apply where evidence and references support them.
Streamed response with inspectable ticket sources
Thumbs feedback + comments; saved conversation history
MongoDB records requests, tools, evidence, usage + errors
Monitoring → inspect behavior Evaluation → retest changes
Optional Langfuse: native traces, observations + feedback
Tool, context and effort budgets apply throughout.
RAG + prompt iteration • Model training and automatic promotion are outside this workflow.
